name: @wizeworks/sms
description: sparx SMS: a provider-agnostic text-messaging abstraction (Twilio-first, swappable). Mirrors @wizeworks/payments, so every caller sends through one interface and never knows the vendor. The main entry is db-free so anything can import it; the ./delivery subpath adds the guarded send (consent, STOP suppression, quiet hours in the recipient's timezone, and a per-tenant ceiling that trips before the provider call) and needs @wizeworks/db.
